# PomodoroConfig

> **File:** `config/PomodoroConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the Pomodoro section: the session and break lengths every pomodoro widget and module runs (see PomodoroManager).

### Properties

- `work` (readonly int): Lengths (ms)
- `shortBreak` (readonly int)
- `longBreak` (readonly int)
- `longBreakEvery` (readonly int): Focus sessions before a long break
- `autoStartBreaks` (readonly bool)
- `autoStartWork` (readonly bool)
- `notify` (readonly bool)
- `settings` (readonly var): The lengths as PomodoroCycle takes them
